description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kotagaloluwa, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320270
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (No. 33 and No. 57) with detailed property information including parcel numbers, extents, owner names, addresses, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses solely on land registration and title settlement processes, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
